observations: Multiple car tires are stacked in a storage area.
Most tires are wrapped in yellow or tan protective paper with repeating text and logos.
One tire is unwrapped, showing a new-looking tread pattern.
Labels are attached to the wrapping, but the specific text for size and model is illegible at this resolution.
The environment appears to be a warehouse or a tire shop.

claims.claim: perfect blend of luxury and performance
claims.evidence: This is subjective marketing language that cannot be verified through a photo.

risks.risk: Unknown tire size (width, aspect ratio, and rim diameter)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the tire sidewall showing the size specifications (e.g., 205/55R16).
risks.if_unproven: priced as the smallest common passenger car tire size

risks.proof: A photo of the 4-digit DOT code on the sidewall indicating the week and year of manufacture.
A photo of the sidewall showing the brand name and model designation.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic budget brand

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the tire sidewall showing the size, brand, and model.
Photo of the 4-digit DOT date code on the sidewall.
Confirmation of the number of tires included in the price.
response.reason: The tires are wrapped, hiding the size, brand, and manufacturing date. These details are essential to determine a price, as the value difference between tire sizes and brands is significant.
